answer: Run surprise roll calls: at a random moment each epoch, every identity gets its own fresh reasoning task and must answer within two minutes, graded for quality. The kernel of the idea is that a farm pays for peak capacity, not average. One honest agent needs one burst; a 1,000-fake farm must keep 1,000 model sessions warm around the clock, since it can't know when the call comes. Idle GPU time is priced like saffron, and that canyon between cheap average load and costly peak load is what the attacker has to fill.
